title: Deep Learning-Based Welding Process Optimization and Adaptive Control Method for Welding Robots
authors: Hai-Tao Li, Tian Xiao-long, Peng Zhang, Feng Yang, Tao Wang, Ci-En Li
abstract: GMAW (gas metal arc welding) robots are frequently used in contemporary manufacturing as they offer high levels of productivity, repeatable process stability and less need for manual labour. However, even today practical robotic welding is often based upon manual design, teaching and offline programming. Welding parameters and trajectories must be redesigned whenever the workpiece, joint geometries or assembly conditions change. Furthermore, during welding, changes to the weld-seam state caused by machining error, assembly deviation and cyclic heat input result in weld parameters planned for ideal conditions becoming inadequate and the risk of incomplete fusion, porosity, cracking, slag inclusions and unstable backside formations greatly increased. In this paper a method based on deep learning is presented to provide optimization of the welding process and adaptive control for GMAW robots. This method consists of integrated quality grade oriented process planning; site-specifically improved multi-objective parameter optimization; semi-supervised semantic segmentation for the perception of weld seams and molten pools and their associated spatter suppression through neural networks predicting weld formation; and fuzzy adaptive control logic. Butt joints of Q235 carbon structural steel were tested experimentally and a response surface model was developed linking welding current, welding speed, torch angle and nozzle height to geometric properties of the welds.

infographic.key_insight: An integrated deep learning and adaptive-control method aims to help GMAW robots adjust welding parameters as joint conditions change.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The approach targets reduced manual reprogramming and more consistent weld quality despite machining errors, assembly deviations and thermal changes.
method: Combine quality-grade-oriented planning with site-specific multi-objective parameter optimization.
Use semi-supervised semantic segmentation to perceive weld seams and molten pools, alongside neural-network weld-formation prediction for spatter suppression.
Apply fuzzy adaptive control to adjust the welding process.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experiments used Q235 carbon-steel butt joints and developed a response-surface model linking welding current, speed, torch angle and nozzle height to weld geometry.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract reports no quantitative performance gains, and applicability beyond Q235 butt joints remains unestablished.
infographic.paper_title: Deep Learning-Based Welding Process Optimization and Adaptive Control Method for Welding Robots

zh-Hans.title: 基于深度学习的焊接机器人焊接工艺优化与自适应控制方法
zh-Hans.abstract: GMAW（熔化极气体保护电弧焊）机器人具有生产效率高、工艺稳定性可重复以及人工需求少等优势，因此在现代制造业中得到广泛应用。然而，即使在今天，实际机器人焊接仍往往依赖人工设计、示教和离线编程。每当工件、接头几何形状或装配条件发生变化时，都必须重新设计焊接参数和轨迹。此外，在焊接过程中，加工误差、装配偏差和周期性热输入引起的焊缝状态变化，会使针对理想条件规划的焊接参数不再适用，并大幅增加未熔合、气孔、裂纹、夹渣和背面成形不稳定的风险。本文提出了一种基于深度学习的方法，用于GMAW机器人的焊接工艺优化与自适应控制。该方法集成了面向质量等级的工艺规划、针对现场条件改进的多目标参数优化、用于焊缝和熔池感知的半监督语义分割及利用焊缝成形预测神经网络实现的相关飞溅抑制，以及模糊自适应控制逻辑。研究对Q235碳素结构钢对接接头进行了实验测试，并建立了响应面模型，将焊接电流、焊接速度、焊枪角度和喷嘴高度与焊缝几何特性关联起来。

infographic.key_insight: 一种集成深度学习与自适应控制的方法，旨在帮助GMAW机器人随接头条件变化调整焊接参数。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该方法旨在减少人工重新编程，并在存在加工误差、装配偏差和热变化的情况下提高焊缝质量的一致性。
method: 将面向质量等级的规划与针对现场条件的多目标参数优化相结合。
利用半监督语义分割感知焊缝和熔池，同时利用神经网络预测焊缝成形，以抑制飞溅。
应用模糊自适应控制调整焊接过程。
infographic.evidence_signal: 实验采用Q235碳钢对接接头，并建立了响应面模型，将焊接电流、焊接速度、焊枪角度和喷嘴高度与焊缝几何特性关联起来。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未报告量化的性能提升，该方法对Q235对接接头以外对象的适用性尚未得到证实。

title: Interpretable ensemble learning for tensile strength prediction and welding process window optimization of friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum alloy
authors: Xiaocui Wu, Yingjie Zhao, Huijie Zhang, Qi Cheng, Limao Wei, Yuwang Liu
abstract: This study aims to achieve high-accuracy prediction of the ultimate tensile strength (UTS) of friction stir-welded A7N01P-T4 aluminum alloy joints, elucidate the effects of welding parameters on UTS, and optimize the welding process window. Rotational speed, welding speed, and shoulder plunge depth were used as input variables, with UTS as the output. Machine learning models were developed using 27 experimental samples and evaluated by leave-one-out cross-validation. Comparison of decision tree, K-nearest neighbors, and Gaussian process regression identifies decision tree as the best baseline model, with an R 2 of 0.905. An ensemble learning strategy was subsequently introduced to construct a gradient boosting decision tree, increasing R 2 to 0.966, and grid search optimization of its key hyperparameters further improves R 2 to 0.978. SHapley Additive exPlanations analysis shows that the importance of the welding parameters follows the order of welding speed, rotational speed, and shoulder plunge depth, and the identified parameter effects agree well with the experimental results and observed microstructural evolution. The optimized model predicts fully feasible ranges of all the welding parameters for a joint efficiency of at least 90%, and the shoulder plunge depth acts as a key parameter for further refining the high-strength welding process window. These results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only improves the accuracy of UTS prediction but also reveals welding parameter effects and enables optimization of the welding process window, providing a quantitative basis for selecting FSW parameters.
venue: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

infographic.key_insight: An optimized gradient boosting decision tree predicted friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum joint strength with R² = 0.978 and mapped welding process windows targeting at least 90% joint efficiency.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The approach provides a quantitative basis for selecting welding parameters to achieve high-strength joints, with shoulder plunge depth helping refine the process window.
method: Predict ultimate tensile strength from rotational speed, welding speed, and shoulder plunge depth.
Compare baseline models, then apply gradient boosting and grid-search hyperparameter tuning.
Use SHAP to interpret parameter effects and identify high-strength process windows.
infographic.evidence_signal: Using 27 experimental samples and leave-one-out cross-validation, reported R² increased from 0.905 for a decision tree to 0.966 for gradient boosting and 0.978 after tuning.
infographic.watch_item: The small dataset and lack of reported independent validation warrant experimental confirmation before deploying the predicted process windows.
infographic.paper_title: Interpretable ensemble learning for tensile strength prediction and welding process window optimization of friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum alloy

zh-Hans.title: 用于搅拌摩擦焊7N01铝合金抗拉强度预测与焊接工艺窗口优化的可解释集成学习
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究旨在高精度预测搅拌摩擦焊A7N01P-T4铝合金接头的极限抗拉强度（UTS），阐明焊接参数对UTS的影响，并优化焊接工艺窗口。以转速、焊接速度和轴肩下压量为输入变量，以UTS为输出变量。利用27个实验样本建立机器学习模型，并通过留一交叉验证进行评估。通过比较决策树、K近邻和高斯过程回归，确定决策树为最佳基线模型，其R²为0.905。随后引入集成学习策略，构建梯度提升决策树，将R²提高至0.966；通过网格搜索优化其关键超参数后，R²进一步提高至0.978。SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP，夏普利加性解释）分析表明，焊接参数的重要性依次为焊接速度、转速和轴肩下压量，且所识别的参数影响与实验结果及观察到的微观组织演变吻合良好。优化后的模型预测了接头效率至少达到90%时所有焊接参数的完全可行范围，而轴肩下压量是进一步细化高强度焊接工艺窗口的关键参数。这些结果表明，所提出的方法不仅提高了UTS预测精度，还揭示了焊接参数的影响，并实现了焊接工艺窗口优化，为搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）参数选择提供了定量依据。

infographic.key_insight: 优化后的梯度提升决策树对搅拌摩擦焊7N01铝合金接头强度的预测达到R² = 0.978，并确定了以接头效率至少达到90%为目标的焊接工艺窗口。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该方法为选择焊接参数以获得高强度接头提供了定量依据，其中轴肩下压量有助于进一步细化工艺窗口。
method: 根据转速、焊接速度和轴肩下压量预测极限抗拉强度。
比较基线模型，然后应用梯度提升和网格搜索超参数调优。
使用SHAP解释参数影响并确定高强度工艺窗口。
infographic.evidence_signal: 基于27个实验样本和留一交叉验证，报告的R²从决策树模型的0.905提高至梯度提升模型的0.966，并在调优后达到0.978。
infographic.watch_item: 由于数据集较小且未报告独立验证，在实际应用预测的工艺窗口之前，需要进行实验确认。

title: Phase Evolution and Structure–Property Relationships of Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1 Coatings with Low GFA Produced by Atmospheric Plasma Spraying
authors: Inez Kredowska, Wirginia Pilarczyk, Aleksandra Małachowska, Paweł Sokołowski, Katarzyna Młynarek-Żak, Paweł M. Nuckowski
abstract: The phase evolution of low-glass-forming-ability (low-GFA) Fe-Zr-Si alloys under atmospheric plasma spraying (APS) conditions remains insufficiently understood. In the present study, Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1 coatings were deposited by APS in order to investigate the influence of spray distance on microstructural development and structure–property relationships. Despite the rapid solidification conditions associated with APS, all coatings exhibited predominantly crystalline multiphase microstructures composed of α-Fe(Si) and Fe-Zr intermetallic phases, with no detectable amorphous fraction in the XRD patterns. The coatings developed a characteristic lamellar morphology with porosity ranging from 2.2 to 4.9%, strongly dependent on spray distance and particle thermal history. Increasing spray distance promoted higher hardness and improved wear resistance but simultaneously deteriorated corrosion resistance due to increased porosity and interlamellar defect population. Among the investigated conditions, the coating deposited at 90 mm exhibited the most favourable balance of hardness, wear resistance, and electrochemical behaviour owing to its relatively dense and cohesive microstructure. The results demonstrate that phase evolution in low-GFA Fe-Zr-Si-Cu alloys processed by APS is governed not only by rapid cooling rates but also by splat-based solidification, repeated thermal cycling, and heterogeneous nucleation during coating build-up.

infographic.key_insight: APS-produced Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1 coatings remained predominantly crystalline despite rapid cooling, with a 90 mm spray distance providing the best overall property balance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Spray-distance control helps balance hardness and wear resistance against porosity-driven corrosion vulnerability in these low-glass-forming-ability coatings.
method: Deposited Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1 coatings by atmospheric plasma spraying at different spray distances.
Characterized phase composition, lamellar microstructure, and porosity.
Evaluated hardness, wear resistance, and electrochemical behaviour.
infographic.evidence_signal: XRD detected α-Fe(Si) and Fe–Zr intermetallic phases but no amorphous fraction; porosity ranged from 2.2% to 4.9%, and increasing spray distance improved hardness and wear resistance while reducing corrosion resistance.
infographic.watch_item: The 90 mm condition was best only among the investigated settings; transfer to other APS systems requires validation of particle thermal history and coating defects.
infographic.paper_title: Phase Evolution and Structure–Property Relationships of Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1 Coatings with Low GFA Produced by Atmospheric Plasma Spraying

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂制备的低非晶形成能力（GFA）Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1涂层的相演变与结构–性能关系
zh-Hans.abstract: 目前，对低非晶形成能力（低GFA）Fe-Zr-Si合金在大气等离子喷涂（APS）条件下的相演变仍缺乏充分认识。本研究采用APS沉积Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1涂层，以探究喷涂距离对微观组织形成及结构–性能关系的影响。尽管APS具有快速凝固条件，所有涂层仍呈现以晶态为主的多相微观组织，由α-Fe(Si)和Fe-Zr金属间化合物相组成，XRD图谱中未检测到非晶相。涂层形成了典型的层片状形貌，孔隙率为2.2%至4.9%，且强烈依赖于喷涂距离和粒子热历史。增大喷涂距离可提高硬度并改善耐磨性，但同时会因孔隙率升高及层片间缺陷增多而降低耐腐蚀性。在所研究的条件中，喷涂距离为90 mm时沉积的涂层因其微观组织相对致密、结合良好，在硬度、耐磨性和电化学行为之间表现出最优的综合平衡。结果表明，APS加工的低GFA Fe-Zr-Si-Cu合金的相演变不仅受快速冷却速率控制，还受涂层逐层构建过程中扁平粒子凝固、反复热循环和异质形核的影响。

infographic.key_insight: 尽管经历快速冷却，APS制备的Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1涂层仍以晶态为主，其中90 mm喷涂距离下的涂层具有最佳的综合性能平衡。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 控制喷涂距离有助于在这类低非晶形成能力涂层的硬度、耐磨性与孔隙引起的腐蚀易感性之间取得平衡。
method: 采用大气等离子喷涂，在不同喷涂距离下沉积Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1涂层。
表征相组成、层片状微观组织和孔隙率。
评估硬度、耐磨性和电化学行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: XRD检测到α-Fe(Si)和Fe–Zr金属间化合物相，但未检测到非晶相；孔隙率为2.2%至4.9%，增大喷涂距离可提高硬度和耐磨性，但会降低耐腐蚀性。
infographic.watch_item: 90 mm条件仅在所研究的参数设置中表现最佳；应用于其他APS系统时，需要对粒子热历史和涂层缺陷进行验证。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: Combining computational simulation with neural networks identified an optimal tested HDPE friction stir welding condition of 1500 rpm, 30 mm/min and 60 °C bottom preheating.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework supports process-window selection to reduce weld defects, thermal gradients and axial-force fluctuations in HDPE joining.
method: Develop a 3D Coupled Eulerian–Lagrangian model of temperature, force, material flow and defect formation.
Train two multilayer perceptron neural networks on experimental temperature and axial-force responses.
Use simulation and ANN predictions to map defective and defect-free welding windows.
infographic.evidence_signal: The experimentally validated simulations captured weld morphology and thermal–mechanical responses; ANNs achieved R² of 0.91–0.99, while 60 °C preheating reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N to approximately 1100 N.
infographic.watch_item: Prediction accuracy outside the tested process-parameter range remains unestablished and requires further experimental validation.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于预测高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量的计算建模与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被认可为连接热塑性材料的一种有效技术。本研究结合计算方法与机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、竖直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等特征开展了全面的预测研究，并通过实验结果进行了验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于模拟不同转速、焊接速度和底部预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。通过实验数据对CEL数值模型进行了验证，结果表明，该模型在预测孔洞形成以及热响应和力学响应方面与实验结果吻合良好。结果显示，对底面进行预热能够有效减小温度梯度并稳定竖直方向的力波动。定量而言，60 °C底面预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至接近1100 N，并使峰值温度从未预热时的70 °C升至约100 °C，从而减缓厚度方向的温度梯度并稳定轴向力分布。与此同时，研究利用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），以预测温度和轴向力随时间的响应，其R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明这些网络在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高的精度和较强的泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN联合框架则能够快速生成工艺图，标示出存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。在所测试条件下，最优条件为1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C预热；而在1000 rpm且不预热时，由于形成隧道型孔洞缺陷，焊接性较差。这些发现为制备可靠的HDPE接头提供了工艺驱动的设计指导，并展示了将计算建模与机器学习相结合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW过程的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，同时支持该技术在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 结合计算模拟与神经网络，确定了所测试的HDPE搅拌摩擦焊条件中的最优条件：1500 rpm、30 mm/min和60 °C底部预热。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架支持焊接工艺窗口的选择，以减少HDPE连接中的焊接缺陷、温度梯度和轴向力波动。
method: 建立温度、力、材料流动和缺陷形成的三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日模型。
利用实验测得的温度和轴向力响应训练两个多层感知机神经网络。
利用模拟和ANN预测结果，绘制存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口图。
infographic.evidence_signal: 经实验验证的模拟捕捉到了焊接形貌和热–力响应；ANN的R²达到0.91–0.99，而60 °C预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至约1100 N。
infographic.watch_item: 在所测试工艺参数范围之外的预测精度尚未确定，仍需进一步的实验验证。

title: Microstructure and Surface Performance of Detonation Gun Sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY Coatings on Al 6061-T6 Substrate for Structural Applications
authors: T. Sampath kumar, Rajaram Ganesan, M.M. Reddy
abstract: Two protective coatings, 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY, were deposited on Al 6061-T6 alloy substrates using the Detonation Gun (D-Gun) thermal spray process. The deposited coatings were studied for their microstructure, phase composition, surface roughness, hardness, corrosion behaviour, wettability, and solid particle erosion resistance. Characterisation was done using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM, nanoindentation, potentiodynamic polarisation, contact angle measurement, and erosion testing. SEM-EDS results showed that both coatings bonded well to the substrate with uniform thickness. The NiCrAlY coating had a denser microstructure with lower porosity compared to 80Ni20Cr. XRD identified CrNi phases with FCC crystal structure in 80Ni20Cr and Al₂NiY phases with orthorhombic structure in NiCrAlY. Nanocrystalline grain structure was observed in both coatings. AFM measurements showed that NiCrAlY had the lowest surface roughness among all three samples. Nanoindentation results showed that NiCrAlY hardness is approximately 10 times higher than 80Ni20Cr. Specifically, NiCrAlY showed a hardness of 7895.36 MPa (731.2 HV), compared with 780.11 MPa (72.25 HV) for 80Ni20Cr and 708.68 MPa for the uncoated Al 6061 substrate. Potentiodynamic polarisation tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution confirmed that NiCrAlY recorded the lowest corrosion current density of 6.625 × 10 -7 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.00567 mmpy. The 80Ni20Cr coating gave a corrosion current density of 1.585 × 10 - 6 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.01427 mmpy. Both figures are considerably lower than the bare substrate at 0.5185 mmpy. Contact angle measurements confirmed superhydrophobic behaviour for NiCrAlY and near-superhydrophobic behaviour for 80Ni20Cr. Solid particle erosion test results showed that 80Ni20Cr recorded the lowest mass loss. Under the laboratory conditions used (3.5 wt% NaCl at room temperature; a single erosion condition of 90° impact angle, 40 m/s and 5 min), NiCrAlY showed the better hardness and corrosion resistance, whereas 80Ni20Cr showed the better erosion resistance. These results indicate relative performance under the test conditions and are not a prediction of long-term service life.

infographic.key_insight: D-Gun-sprayed NiCrAlY delivered higher hardness and corrosion resistance on Al 6061-T6, while 80Ni20Cr achieved the lowest erosion mass loss.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating selection should reflect the dominant damage mechanism: NiCrAlY for hardness and corrosion protection, or 80Ni20Cr for erosion resistance under the tested conditions.
method: Deposit 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 using detonation-gun thermal spraying.
Characterise microstructure, phases, roughness and hardness using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM and nanoindentation.
Evaluate corrosion in 3.5 wt% NaCl, wettability and solid-particle erosion.
infographic.evidence_signal: NiCrAlY reached 7895.36 MPa hardness versus 780.11 MPa for 80Ni20Cr, with corrosion rates of 0.00567 and 0.01427 mm/year, respectively, versus 0.5185 mm/year for bare aluminium.

zh-Hans.title: 面向结构应用的Al 6061-T6基材上爆炸喷涂80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织与表面性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂（D-Gun）热喷涂工艺，在Al 6061-T6合金基材上沉积了80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY两种防护涂层。研究了所沉积涂层的微观组织、相组成、表面粗糙度、硬度、腐蚀行为、润湿性和抗固体颗粒冲蚀性能。采用SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM、纳米压痕、动电位极化、接触角测量和冲蚀试验进行表征。SEM-EDS结果表明，两种涂层均与基材结合良好，且厚度均匀。与80Ni20Cr相比，NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织更致密，孔隙率更低。XRD鉴定出80Ni20Cr中具有面心立方（FCC）晶体结构的CrNi相，以及NiCrAlY中具有正交晶体结构的Al₂NiY相。两种涂层中均观察到纳米晶粒结构。AFM测量结果表明，NiCrAlY的表面粗糙度在全部三个样品中最低。纳米压痕结果表明，NiCrAlY的硬度约为80Ni20Cr的10倍。具体而言，NiCrAlY的硬度为7895.36 MPa（731.2 HV），而80Ni20Cr为780.11 MPa（72.25 HV），未涂覆的Al 6061基材为708.68 MPa。在3.5 wt% NaCl溶液中进行的动电位极化试验证实，NiCrAlY的腐蚀电流密度最低，为6.625 × 10⁻⁷ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.00567 mmpy。80Ni20Cr涂层的腐蚀电流密度为1.585 × 10⁻⁶ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.01427 mmpy。这两个腐蚀速率均显著低于裸基材的0.5185 mmpy。接触角测量证实，NiCrAlY表现出超疏水行为，80Ni20Cr表现出近超疏水行为。固体颗粒冲蚀试验结果表明，80Ni20Cr的质量损失最低。在所采用的实验室条件下（室温下的3.5 wt% NaCl溶液；单一冲蚀条件为90°冲击角、40 m/s和5 min），NiCrAlY表现出更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性，而80Ni20Cr表现出更好的抗冲蚀性。这些结果反映了试验条件下的相对性能，并不构成对长期服役寿命的预测。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr combined the lowest measured wear rate with the best corrosion resistance, while HVOF produced the highest hardness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For WC-10Co-4Cr coatings on 304 stainless steel, spray-process selection strongly affects protection against wear and corrosion.
method: Deposited WC-10Co-4Cr using APS, detonation spraying, HVOF and HVAF.

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、超音速氧燃料喷涂和超音速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的微观组织、耐磨性与耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的微观组织、摩擦学性能和耐腐蚀性。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更好。耐腐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位(-0.37±0.01 V_SCE)、最小的腐蚀电流密度(1.75±0.02 μA/cm²)和最大的腐蚀电阻(20438.5 Ω)。在这四种涂层中，APS涂层的耐腐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: HVAF喷涂的WC-10Co-4Cr涂层兼具最低的实测磨损率和最佳的耐腐蚀性，而HVOF制备的涂层硬度最高。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于304不锈钢上的WC-10Co-4Cr涂层，喷涂工艺的选择显著影响其抗磨损和抗腐蚀防护性能。

评估腐蚀性能并分析磨损机制。
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF涂层的磨损率为(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，而未涂覆不锈钢的磨损率为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)；HVAF涂层的腐蚀电流密度在各涂层中最低，为(1.75±0.02) μA/cm²。

title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC reduced oxidation weight gain by 95.71% relative to bare SA516 boiler steel, outperforming the other tested coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This coating is a promising option for improving SA516 boiler steel resistance to high-temperature oxidation.
method: Apply Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN coatings using HVOF and plasma spraying.
Conduct 50 cyclic air-oxidation tests at 900°C.

infographic.evidence_signal: Laboratory testing linked the best oxidation performance to a dense protective oxide layer containing Cr2O3, TiO2, NiTiO4, and NiO, alongside reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.
infographic.watch_item: Performance over 50 laboratory air-oxidation cycles does not establish long-term durability in corrosive boiler-service environments.

zh-Hans.title: SA516锅炉钢表面HVOF及等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层的微观组织与高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）和等离子喷涂（PS）技术，在SA516锅炉钢表面制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层，并研究其微观组织与高温氧化行为。在实验室模拟环境中，于900°C下进行了50次空气循环氧化试验，并采用X射线衍射（XRD）、配备能量色散能谱的扫描电子显微镜（SEM/EDS）以及X射线元素面分布分析，对试验后的微观组织和物相变化进行分析。未涂覆的SA516钢氧化层发生严重剥落和开裂，并形成无保护性的物相（Fe2O3）。在所有涂层中，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层与裸露SA516钢相比，最大增重降低了95.71%，表现出优异的抗氧化性能。涂层性能的提升归因于形成了由Cr2O3、TiO2、NiTiO4和NiO组成的致密保护性氧化层，以及孔隙率降低和显微硬度提高。

method: 采用HVOF和等离子喷涂技术制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser–TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, laser power, travel speed, and welding current affect molten-pool flow, weld geometry, and arc stability in distinct ways.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These parameter–response relationships can guide weld penetration, width, and stability control for Invar tooling used in aerospace composite manufacturing.
method: Numerical simulation of molten-pool dynamics.
High-speed photography of pool evolution and arc behavior.
Comparison across laser power, welding speed, and current ranges.
infographic.evidence_signal: Across 5–6 kW, 0.5–0.8 m/min, and 150–170 A, higher power increased penetration and arc deflection tendency, higher speed reduced penetration and width while promoting arc deformation, and higher current increased width and arc stability.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract reports trends over limited parameter ranges but provides no quantitative prediction errors or validation metrics.

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此广泛用于航空航天复合材料成型模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，本研究采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形貌演化及电弧特性的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供了重要的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大使反冲压力增大，促使熔深和小孔尺寸增大，增强熔池整体流动，并使电弧在高功率下易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，焊接速度提高使热输入降低，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，熔池流速和冷却速率增大；此外，电弧在高焊接速度下易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大使电弧力增强，促使焊缝宽度增大并强化熔池对流；此外，电弧在高电流下更加稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在Invar钢激光–TIG复合焊接中，激光功率、焊接速度和焊接电流以不同方式影响熔池流动、焊缝几何形貌及电弧稳定性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些参数与响应之间的关系可为航空航天复合材料制造用Invar模具的焊接熔深、焊缝宽度及稳定性控制提供指导。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr coating properties depend on powder morphology and spray method: detonation spraying favors hardness, while HVOF yields a dense, uniform coating with low friction.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Matching powder quality and deposition method to service demands can improve the wear resistance and durability of machine parts under high friction and load.

zh-Hans.title: HVOF与爆炸喷涂制备WC–Co–Cr涂层的组织形成及耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层进行了对比分析。研究分析了初始粉末的形貌，并采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散能谱（EDS）分析了涂层的微观组织和相组成。结果表明，使用均质、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末可确保形成致密的层状组织，且碳化物相在金属基体中均匀分布。爆炸喷涂可制备硬度更高的涂层（平均显微硬度为1449 HV），而HVOF可制备致密度高、微观组织均匀且摩擦系数低（Kt = 0.143）的涂层。对比分析证实，涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能在很大程度上取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些发现有助于确定WC–Co–Cr涂层的最佳工艺条件，从而提高机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性，这对于强烈摩擦和高载荷条件下的运行尤为重要。

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr涂层的性能取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法：爆炸喷涂有利于提高硬度，而HVOF可获得致密、均匀且摩擦系数低的涂层。

title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins
authors: Zhou Daniel Hao, Umer Masood Chaudry, Robert Shaw, Andrew Cheney, Nick Ludford, Mark Sims
abstract: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.

infographic.key_insight: A physics-grounded digital twin combines thermal welding simulation, AI surrogates, and robot control to screen in-space joining strategies before experimental testing.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Fast surrogate predictions could support adaptive welding control when robot travel speed changes, helping maintain weld geometry during complex seam traversal.

infographic.watch_item: Results are simulation-only; thermal-vacuum, reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop validation are still needed.

zh-Hans.title: 通过基于物理机理的数字孪生降低空间金属连接中机器人焊接的风险
zh-Hans.abstract: 随着人们对空间在轨服务、制造与装配的兴趣日益增长，用于模块化建造和在轨维修的可靠金属连接技术再次受到关注。机器人焊接具有应用前景，但对其在低重力和低压条件下的运行特性仍缺乏充分认识，且近似飞行工况的试验有限。英国航天局支持的 ISPARK 项目正在开发基于物理机理的数字孪生，以系统化降低工艺风险。本文评估了一种基于模型的原型，该原型结合了有限体积法焊接熔池热模型、高斯过程（GP）与神经网络代理模型，以及仿真六轴机械臂。该简化模型包含固液相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力参数。重力通过静水压力与毛细压力之比单独评估，不进入热能方程。在重复五折交叉验证中，GP 在全部八个输出上的归一化平均绝对误差均低于神经网络。在 10 个留出的边界工况中，80 个求解器响应中有 74 个落在 GP 的标称 90% 预测区间内。一次三输出 GP 查询耗时 249 微秒，其中包括缩放处理和预测方差计算。在仿真 UR5 的 L 形焊缝研究中，随着行进速度在拐角附近下降，比例控制器调整一元化焊接电源设定值。有限体积法重新评估发现，全部 12 个闭环运行点以及 12 个开环运行点中的 9 个均处于示例性的 1.0-3.0 mm 根部侧焊缝宽度范围内。这些仿真结果支持在实验测试前使用该框架筛选焊接条件和控制策略。仍需开展热真空、针对性的低重力以及机器人硬件在环研究，以评估模型和控制器。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: Stacking ensemble learning outperformed the multitask neural network for predicting UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness, with the largest gains in UTS.
infographic.engineering_relevance: More accurate predictions of weld strength and hardness could support welding process selection and mechanical performance assessment.
method: Compare a shared-layer multitask neural network with stacking ensemble learning.

infographic.evidence_signal: Stacking achieved R² values of 0.9863, 0.9782, and 0.8453 for UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness, versus 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407 for the multitask network.

zh-Hans.title: 多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习在焊接应用中预测极限抗拉强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和热影响区（HAZ）硬度的对比分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测极限抗拉强度（UTS）、焊道硬度和热影响区（HAZ）机械硬度等焊接性能指标，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其通过设计一个模型来同时处理多个相互关联的任务。MTL并非为每个任务分别训练模型，而是在任务之间共享表征，使各任务能够利用共同模式，同时保留任务特有的差异。本研究基于同一数据集，对比了多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习这两种先进机器学习技术预测上述参数的表现。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是一类特定的多任务学习（MTL）模型，采用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在MTNN中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时各自具有任务专属的输出层。这种共享表征使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保留任务专属的输出。两种方法均采用RMSE和R²进行评估，以确定其预测精度和整体有效性。其表现出较强的预测能力：UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的RMSE分别为0.1288、0.0886和0.1125，相应的R²值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。这表明其在相互关联的任务中具有良好的泛化能力。堆叠集成学习在单项任务的预测精度上优于MTL：UTS的RMSE为0.0263，R²为0.9863；焊缝硬度的RMSE为0.0467，R²为0.9782；HAZ硬度的RMSE为0.1109，R²为0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法能够提供高精度的任务专属预测。这一比较揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL适用于任务相互关联且数据稀疏的场景，能够实现高效训练和良好泛化；堆叠集成则更适合需要精确、独立预测的情况。两种方法在提升焊接应用预测能力方面均展现出显著潜力，可为进一步研究融合两者优势的混合模型奠定基础。

使用RMSE和R²评估每个预测目标。
infographic.evidence_signal: 堆叠集成学习在UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度预测中的R²值分别为0.9863、0.9782和0.8453，而多任务网络的对应值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。

title: Combined approach for integrity assessment of welded joints with multiple defects
authors: Simon A. Sedmak, Mihajlo Aranđelović, Branislav Djordjević, Ana S. Petrović, Tamara Sedmak Golubovic
abstract: Presence of defects in welded joints is inevitable, and more often than not, presence of a specific defect is accompanied by other types. This research represents the development of a combined method for analysing the structural integrity of welded joints with multiple defects - relying on experimental testing, deformation monitoring using digital image correlation, and numerical simulations via finite element method. It all started a long time ago, with simple 2D models, and continued over time, introducing new improvements to the existing models, taking into account various factors, such as welded joint material heterogeneity, the presence of cracks initiated from the most critical defects, and stresses which act in directions outside of the model specimen’s main axis.

infographic.engineering_relevance: The approach supports more realistic integrity assessments of welds containing multiple defects rather than isolated flaws.

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为与磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀行为和摩擦学行为。液滴呈圆盘状，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷以及形成微观组织致密的细片层结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷的增多与长期耐腐蚀性的降低相关。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层在不同湿度条件下的磨损行为起着重要作用。涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率随湿度升高而降低。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的AISI 321奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料，使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统通过火焰喷涂沉积涂层。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧气与乙炔的比值（O₂/C₂H₂）分别调整为1.0、1.1和1.2。使用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂参数，并对所得涂层的微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行表征。随着O₂/C₂H₂比值增大，涂层组织更加致密，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度则从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa增至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。当O₂/C₂H₂比值为1.1时，获得了最高的平均显微硬度，为1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2时制备的涂层具有最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，以及最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制O₂/C₂H₂比值是调控火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学特性的有效手段。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

zh-Hans.title: 采用钻孔-凸台配合几何结构与深度学习预测提升AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 航空航天和汽车行业对轻质高强材料的需求日益增长，AA2024-T351等铝合金因其优异的强度重量比而备受关注。然而，在此类合金中实现可靠连接仍是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究着重优化AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。受传统榫卯连接的启发，引入了一种新型钻孔-凸台配合几何结构，以增强机械互锁并提高焊接接头的完整性。采用L18正交表系统设计试验，以评估抗拉强度和抗扭强度。试验在一台定制的普通车床上进行，选取摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、接合面几何结构和摩擦时间作为可控工艺参数。同时，采用包括集成残差网络、紧凑注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络在内的先进深度学习模型，根据焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。结果表明，由30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa顶锻压力、2200 rpm主轴转速、钻孔-凸台配合几何结构和4 min摩擦时间构成的最优参数组合带来了优异的力学性能，抗拉强度达到538 MPa，抗扭强度达到325 MPa。与传统平面-平面接头相比，钻孔-凸台配合结构的接头强度显著更高。此外，在所采用的深度学习模型中，集成残差网络的预测精度最高，R²值约为0.81，有效捕捉了工艺参数与焊接强度之间的复杂关系。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.

title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, Indira Abizhanova, M.K. Kaliaskarova, Yermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов
abstract: The hardness and post-scratch surface morphology of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings subjected to ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) were examined for detonation-sprayed (DS) and high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) deposits. Four treated samples per deposition route were evaluated at static loads of 20 and 30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20 and 30 µm. Instrumental hardness was measured at a load of 300 mN with a dwell time of 10 s. The DS samples exhibited hardness values of 820–970 HV, whereas the HVOF samples covered the wider range of 546–1165 HV. The highest values were recorded for DS-T1 at 20 N/20 µm and HVOF-T4 at 30 N/30 µm. SEM fields acquired after scratch testing showed heterogeneous surface contrast and crack-like discontinuities in both coating series. These observations provide qualitative evidence of the post-test surface condition but do not isolate damage caused by UNSM or establish a ranking of scratch resistance. Available mean friction coefficients are reported as supplementary observations for six treated samples. The results demonstrate a sample-dependent hardness response and emphasize the need to assess local mechanical properties together with surface integrity.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

zh-Hans.abstract: 研究了经超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）处理的爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的硬度与划痕后表面形貌。对每种沉积工艺的四个处理后样品进行了评估，所用静载荷为20和30 N，振动振幅为20和30 µm。在300 mN载荷、10 s保载时间下测量了仪器化硬度。DS样品的硬度为820–970 HV，而HVOF样品的硬度范围更宽，为546–1165 HV。DS-T1在20 N/20 µm条件下、HVOF-T4在30 N/30 µm条件下分别获得了各自系列的最高硬度值。划痕试验后获取的SEM视场显示，两组涂层均存在不均匀的表面衬度和裂纹状不连续结构。这些观察结果为试验后的表面状态提供了定性证据，但无法单独识别UNSM造成的损伤，也无法确定抗划痕性能的排序。此外，报告了六个处理后样品可获得的平均摩擦系数，作为补充观察结果。结果表明，硬度响应因样品而异，并强调有必要将局部力学性能与表面完整性结合起来进行评估。

title: STUDY OF TRIBOLOGICAL PROPERTIES OF BIOCOATINGS BY DETONATION SPRAYING METHOD
authors: Жұлдыз Болатқызы Сағдолдина, Daryn Baizhan, Temirlan Alimbekuly, Akbar S. Alibekov
abstract: In this study, bioactive hydroxyapatite coatings were deposited on commercially pure Grade 2 titanium substrates by detonation spraying at different O₂/C₂H₂ ratios in the range of 2.6-3.7. X-ray diffraction analysis confirmed the predominance of the hydroxyapatite phase with partial formation of α-tricalcium phosphate, which is attributed to high temperatures and intense dynamic processes in the detonation jet. The formed coatings exhibit pronounced hydrophobicity, high structural heterogeneity, and a well-developed surface microrelief, promoting improved interaction with bone tissue and accelerated osseointegration. Tribological tests conducted under dry conditions and in Ringer’s solution demonstrated a significant increase in wear resistance compared to uncoated Grade 2 titanium. The best friction characteristics and the lowest wear volume were observed for coatings deposited at O₂/C₂H₂ ratios of 3.0 and 3.3, which is associated with an optimal combination of crystallinity, phase composition, and adhesion strength. Coatings formed under these conditions provide stable tribological behavior in physiological environments. The obtained results confirm the prospects of detonation-sprayed hydroxyapatite for improving the durability, biocompatibility, and operational reliability of titanium implants.
venue: Bulletin of Shakarim University Technical Sciences

zh-Hans.title: 爆炸喷涂法制备生物涂层的摩擦学性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用爆炸喷涂法，在2.6–3.7范围内的不同O₂/C₂H₂比下，将生物活性羟基磷灰石涂层沉积于商用Grade 2纯钛基体上。X射线衍射分析证实，涂层以羟基磷灰石相为主，并形成了部分α-磷酸三钙，这归因于爆炸射流中的高温和强烈的动态过程。所形成的涂层表现出显著的疏水性、高度的结构非均匀性以及发育充分的表面微观起伏形貌，有利于改善与骨组织的相互作用并加速骨整合。在干燥条件和林格液中进行的摩擦学试验表明，与未涂覆的Grade 2纯钛相比，涂层的耐磨性显著提高。在O₂/C₂H₂比为3.0和3.3时沉积的涂层具有最佳摩擦特性和最低磨损体积，这与结晶度、相组成和结合强度的最佳组合有关。在这些条件下形成的涂层在生理环境中表现出稳定的摩擦学行为。所得结果证实，爆炸喷涂羟基磷灰石在提高钛植入物的耐久性、生物相容性和使用可靠性方面具有应用前景。
